message.content: {"caption":"Two side-by-side horizontal bar charts compare SpreadsheetBench-Vrf scores for Gemma-4 and GPT-5.5 users across baseline and skill conditions.","description":"The figure contains two horizontal bar charts, titled “Gemma-4 user” (left) and “GPT-5.5 user” (right). Both use SpreadsheetBench-Vrf (%) on the horizontal axis, with ticks at 0, 20, 40, 60, and 80. The legend maps gray to No trace, purple to Qwen traces, blue to Gemma-4 traces, and green to GPT-5.5 traces. In each panel, the categories are No Skill, Human-Written, 122B Deepen +Comb., 35B Deepen +Comb., Self Deepen +Err., and Self Deepen +Comb. The left panel’s bars are gray for the first two baselines, purple for the two 122B/35B conditions, and blue for the two self conditions. Its highest score is Self Deepen +Err. at 60.5; 122B Deepen +Comb. scores 55.5, and the other bars range from 37.7 to 47.2. The right panel uses gray for the baselines, purple for the 122B/35B conditions, and green for the self conditions. Its highest score is Self Deepen +Err. at 83.5, closely followed by Self Deepen +Comb. at 81.0; the two Qwen-trace conditions score 78.5 and 62.5. No Skill is lower for the GPT-5.5 user than for Gemma-4 (32.5 versus 41.2), while the other listed conditions are higher in the GPT-5.5-user panel.
